name: Voidflower Garden
introDiscord:
Flowers bloom in empty space.

No soil.

No stems.

Some grow upside down.

Several blooms contain tiny windows into other places.
introTwitch:
Flowers bloom in empty space.

No soil.

No stems.

Some grow upside down.

Several blooms contain tiny windows into other places.

voidflower-garden-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Voidflower Garden.

left.message:
A pale flower opens and releases restorative light.

Shizuki's note:

'Pretty flower.

Did not bite.

★★★★★.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A Voidflower Mantis unfolds from petals that were absolutely a flower
one second ago.

forward.message: A cache sits inside the hollow center of a bloom.

voidflower-garden-depths.prompt: Deeper within Voidflower Garden, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
One Berry grows from a plant with no visible connection to reality.

Shizuki wrote:

'Berry agriculture attempt nine.

SUCCESS?!

I DON'T KNOW WHAT PLANT IS ATTACHED TO.'

right.message: Star Candies hide inside a flower displaying a tiny Moonlit Reef.

forward.message: A Mantis steps out of a black blossom.

voidflower-garden-threshold.prompt: Near Garden Outside Space, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Voidflower Mantis imitates a closed bloom until you pass.

right.message: A luminous flower releases restorative pollen.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A perfect blossom opens around a treasure cache.

boss-antechamber.name: Garden Outside Space
boss-antechamber.prompt: Garden Outside Space blossoms all at once.

bossPromptDiscord:
Garden Outside Space blossoms all at once.

One flower is enormous.

Then the petals stand up.

Use /yes to enter or /no to permanently distrust flowers.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Garden Outside Space. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The central bloom unfolds into claws.

Nothing-Bloom Mantis reveals itself!

completionText:
The Garden becomes peaceful again.

Shizuki's review has been updated:

'Pretty flower.

SOME bite.

★★★☆☆.'
